title: Dalt0n's Perfect Vanilla Experience
description: Dalt0n's Perfect Vanilla Experience is a client-side Fabric modpack for Minecraft 1.21.4. It enhances visuals, sounds, animations, and quality of life without changing gameplay. Fully compatible with any vanilla server and safe to use.
body:
![Dalt0n's Perfect Vanilla Experience](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d34771f312d87b2baf1fc6f7ef0e4a0e1b211440_0.webp)# Dalt0n's Perfect Vanilla Experience

**A comprehensive visual, audio, and quality-of-life overhaul for Minecraft 1.21.4 (Fabric).**  
Enhance every aspect of the game – from stunning shaders and realistic animations to immersive sounds and performance optimizations – while keeping the **vanilla gameplay untouched**.

---

## 🎯 What does this modpack do?

This modpack is designed for players who want **Minecraft to look, sound, and feel better** without altering core mechanics. It works on any server (as long as clients are allowed to use cosmetic/performance mods) and is completely **client-side**.

### ✨ Visual Enhancements
- **Better Leaves**, **3D crops**, **3D ladders & rails**, glowing ores, and **3D mace**.
- **Dramatic Skys**, **Bliss shaders** (edit by Chocapic13) & **I Like Vanilla shaders** for realistic lighting and skies.
- **Fresh Animations** – lifelike mob and player animations.
- **Visual Snowy Leaves**, **Falling Leaves**, and **Wavey Capes**.
- **3D skin layers**, **entity model & texture features**, and **skyboxify**.
- **Sodium**, **Iris**, **Continuity**, **More Culling**, and **ImmediatelyFast** for high FPS and smooth rendering.

### 🔊 Audio & Immersion
- **Ambient Sounds** and **Sound Physics Remastered** for realistic audio.
- **Better Beds**, **Better Lanterns**, **Low on Fire**, and **Theone’s Eating Animation**.
- **Not Enough Animations**, **Better Third Person**, **Hold F5**, and **Chat Animation**.
- **Particle Effects** and **Inventory Particles** for subtle visual feedback.

### 🖥️ User Interface & Quality of Life
- **Xaero’s Minimap** & **World Map**, **Jade**, **AppleSkin**, **Better Stats**, **Legendary Tooltips**.
- **Controlling**, **Mouse Tweaks**, **Item Borders**, **Shield Fixes**, **Small Shield & Totem**.
- **Mod Menu**, **Clumps**, **Cloth Config**, **Yet Another Config Lib**.
- **Hold My Item** – shows your held item more clearly in the UI.
- **Resource Pack Overrides** – automatically enables the included resource packs.
- **Voice Chat** (Simple Voice Chat) – optional, works on servers that support it.

### ⚙️ Performance & Stability
- **Lithium**, **FerriteCore**, **Entity Culling**, **Memory Leak Fix**, **More Culling**, **ImmediatelyFast**.
- **Fabric API**, **Fabric Language Kotlin**, and essential libraries for compatibility.

---

---

## ⚙️ Requirements & Installation

- **Minecraft Version:** 1.21.4  
- **Mod Loader:** Fabric  
- **Recommended:** Install via the **Modrinth App** using the `.mrpack` file.  
- **Manual:** Import the `.mrpack` into any launcher that supports Modrinth packs (Prism Launcher, ATLauncher, etc.).

> ⚠️ **Note:** This modpack is **client-side**. It does not require server installation, but servers may restrict certain client mods (e.g., minimap with entities). Always check server rules.

---

## 🙏 Credits

This modpack is a collection of amazing work from the Minecraft modding community. All mods, resource packs, and shaders are used with respect to their original licenses. Special thanks to every creator who made this experience possible.

- **Mods:** Fabric API, Sodium, Iris, Lithium, Xaero’s Maps, Jade, AmbientSounds, Sound Physics, Hold My Item, and many more.  
- **Resource Packs:** FreshAnimations, Dramatic Skys, RAYs 3D, Vanilla+, etc.  
- **Shaders:** Bliss (Chocapic13 edit), I Like Vanilla.

For a full list of included projects, please refer to the **dependencies** section of this modpack page or view the `.mrpack` contents.
